shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger. The skill shot is a soft plunge that dies in the top loop and rolls back into Rudy's Hideout rather than a full-power shot.

shots.name: Rudy's Hideout
shots.notes: A kicker tucked behind Rudy's head. Target of the skill shot, and worth 75K any time you find it during normal play.

shots.name: Trapdoor Loop
shots.notes: Running this loop is what opens the Trapdoor. It also advances the clock 10 minutes and flashes the right Gangway.

shots.name: Trapdoor
shots.notes: Open for roughly eight seconds after a loop. The big-ticket shot of the game and the Million-plus shot during Midnight Multiball. Disabled during Quick Multiball.

shots.name: Center Ramp
shots.notes: Normally returns to the left inlane, but diverts to the Steps plunger when the blue STEPS light is on at its entrance. Reopens the Trapdoor during Midnight Multiball.

shots.name: Rudy
shots.notes: The dummy head. His jaw is hit from the side flipper; his mouth only falls open at midnight. He talks constantly, and that matters — see Rudy Gulp.

shots.name: Side Flipper
shots.notes: The upper flipper that feeds Rudy's jaw. Jaw hits build the end-of-ball bonus and relight the Mirror.

shots.name: Wind Tunnel / Mystery Mirror
shots.notes: Awards 15 clock minutes normally, or the flashing Mirror award when the white MIRROR light is on. Once all six Mirror awards are collected it starts Super Frenzy instead.

shots.name: Hidden Hallway
shots.notes: The ball lock, and where the extra ball light lives. Advances the clock 10 minutes. Above 11:30 this is the only shot that moves the clock at all.

shots.name: Steps Ramp
shots.notes: Reached from the Center Ramp or a left outlane drain once Steps Open has been awarded. Three lit steps sit on it; shooting all the way to the top buys 20 seconds of Superdog.

shots.name: S-T-E-P Targets
shots.notes: Complete all four to light one unlit step. The order is fixed — Light Frenzy first, 500K second, Light Extra Ball last. Every individual target you hit also adds 5 clock minutes, so a full pass through the bank is worth 20.

shots.name: Superdog Targets
shots.notes: Add 5 clock minutes each. Superdog time freezes several of the game's timers while it runs.

shots.name: Jet Bumpers (3)
shots.notes: Worth 0 clock minutes unlit, 5 when lit and 10 when flashing. The lane between the bumpers and the right inlanes lights an unlit bumper or flashes a lit one.

shots.name: Manhole
shots.notes: Below the jet bumpers. The single biggest clock advance in the game at 30 minutes, and it opens the Steps.

shots.name: Left Gangway
shots.notes: Set flashing by the inside right inlane. Hitting it while it flashes pays a value that carries between balls until the extra ball is lit.

shots.name: Right Gangway
shots.notes: Set flashing by the Trapdoor loop or the left inlane. Gangway lights only stay on a few seconds, so the follow-up has to be immediate.

shots.name: Right Center Lane
shots.notes: Relights the MIRROR light for about four seconds — a cheap way to re-arm the Mystery Mirror without going near Rudy.

shots.name: The Clock
shots.notes: Starts at 8:00 and holds its value between balls. Almost everything you do moves it. It resets to 5:00 after the Midnight Multiball sequence finishes.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Flashes the right Gangway. Where the Center Ramp returns the ball when Steps are not open.

shots.name: Inside Right Inlane
shots.notes: Flashes the left Gangway.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Not always fatal — once Steps Open is awarded, a left outlane drain feeds the Steps plunger instead.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Carries the Special light once the clock reaches 11:30 for a second time in a game.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Trapdoor loop and the right side of the playfield.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Center Ramp, Wind Tunnel and Hidden Hallway.

goals.title: Plunger Skill Shot
goals.summary: Not a full-power plunge. You want the ball to run out of speed in the top loop and roll back down into Rudy's Hideout. It pays 250K the first time, then 500K, 750K and a million every time after.

steps.action: Plunge softly so the ball stalls in the top loop
steps.detail: Not a full-power plunge — you want it to run out of speed in the loop and roll back down into the Hideout, where the kicker sits behind Rudy's head. Value climbs with each collection.

goals.title: Advance The Clock
goals.summary: The clock is FunHouse. It starts at 8:00, holds between balls, and getting it to midnight is the entire game. Almost every shot moves it, so knowing which ones move it most is the difference between reaching Rudy and running out of balls.
instructions: Biggest advances: the Manhole and starting a ball are both worth 30 minutes.
Middle tier: the Wind Tunnel and Center Ramp give 15 minutes — the ramp then climbs to 20, 25 and 30 on repeat hits.
Small change: Hidden Hallway and the Trapdoor and its loop give 10 each; STEP and Superdog targets give 5.
Jet bumpers give nothing unlit, 5 lit, 10 flashing — so lighting them first genuinely matters.
Frenzy and Quick Multiball both cap the clock at 11:25 — do not waste those seconds trying to push it further.
At 11:30 the only thing that advances it is locking a ball in the Hidden Hallway, which takes you to 11:45; the next lock is midnight.

goals.title: The Trapdoor Ladder
goals.summary: Run the Trapdoor loop and the Trapdoor opens for about eight seconds. The first is worth 500K off a single loop; after that it takes two consecutive loops for 750K, and three for a million. The price goes up as the prize does.

steps.detail: One loop opens it the first time; later opens need two then three consecutive loops
A ball rolling back over the loop sensor behind the Trapdoor also collects the award

goals.title: Center Ramp Repeat
goals.summary: 75K and 15 minutes to start, climbing to 100K, 125K and 150K with 30 minutes from then on. It resets every ball and after Midnight Multiball, so the value is something you rebuild rather than bank.

steps.detail: Each hit is worth more than the last until it caps
With it lit at the ramp entrance, your ramp shot ends at the Steps plunger, not the left inlane

goals.title: Gangway Awards
goals.summary: The inlanes cross-light the Gangways — right inlane flashes the left one, left inlane and the Trapdoor loop flash the right. They pay 150K, 200K, 250K and then 250K plus the extra ball light. The lights die after a few seconds, so this is a reflex shot.
goals.reward: 150K climbing to 250K, then lights extra ball

steps.detail: This starts the left Gangway flashing

steps.action: Hit it while it is still flashing
steps.detail: You have only a few seconds; hitting an unlit Gangway just starts it flashing instead
That value survives from ball to ball right up until Extra Ball lights; every ball after that one starts the Gangway back at 75K

goals.title: Mystery Mirror
goals.summary: With the white MIRROR light on, the Wind Tunnel pays whichever of six awards is flashing. The light is on at the start of every ball, goes out when you collect, and comes back on when you hit Rudy's jaw — or briefly from the right centre lane.

steps.action: Relight the Mirror off Rudy's jaw
steps.detail: The right centre lane also relights it, for about four seconds

steps.action: Shoot the Wind Tunnel while lit
steps.detail: Awards include Extra Ball Is Lit, Million Is Lit, Jet Bumpers At Maximum, Steps Open and Quick Multiball

goals.title: The Steps
goals.summary: Three lit steps on their own ramp, reached via the Center Ramp or — unusually — a left outlane drain, once Steps Open has been awarded. The S-T-E-P targets light them in a fixed order, and the last one is the extra ball.

steps.detail: Each completion lights one step: Light Frenzy first, then 500K, then Light Extra Ball
Collecting a step turns its light off; an unlit step is only worth 100K

steps.action: Shoot to the very top for Superdog
steps.detail: Reaching the top of the ramp buys 20 seconds of Superdog time

goals.title: Frenzy
goals.summary: Light Frenzy from the Steps, then hit the Trapdoor. Every playfield target adds 50K to a bonus that pays out at the end of the ball — which is the catch, because a tilt throws all of it away.
goals.reward: 120K base, +50K per target, paid at end of ball

steps.detail: The Trapdoor swings open and its Frenzy light comes on — that light will not go out until you cash it in

steps.action: Hit the Trapdoor to start Frenzy
steps.detail: Twenty seconds on the clock, paused whenever Superdog time would pause
Any target adds 50K. Collecting another Frenzy mid-Frenzy adds 20 seconds. Do not tilt — the bonus is only paid at end of ball

goals.title: Super Frenzy
goals.summary: Hidden behind the Mirror. Once all six Mirror awards have been collected, the Wind Tunnel stops giving awards and starts Super Frenzy instead — 1.5M base with every target worth 100K.

steps.action: Collect all six Mirror awards first
steps.detail: This is the only way to arm it, and nothing on the playfield announces it
Starting Super Frenzy during a normal Frenzy adds 20 seconds and upgrades the whole thing

goals.title: Quick Multiball
goals.summary: A Mirror award. A second ball arrives, and the first launches as soon as the new one hits anything. While both are alive every Rudy hit is worth a million — but the Trapdoor is switched off and the clock will not pass 11:25.

steps.action: Draw Quick Multiball from the Mirror
steps.detail: Ball two either gets served to you or fires out of the Hidden Hallway
Every hit is a million until you are back down to one ball

goals.title: Midnight Multiball
goals.summary: The whole point of the machine. Get the clock to midnight, Rudy falls asleep and his mouth drops open — shoot it. The Trapdoor then becomes a ladder: 2M, then 3M, climbing a million each time up to ten.
goals.reward: 2M climbing by 1M per Trapdoor hit, max 10M

steps.detail: Above 11:30 locking is the only thing that moves the clock
Worth 1M, or 2M if Million was also lit from the Mirror
The hit closes the Trapdoor again

steps.action: Reopen it with the Center Ramp
steps.detail: Each cycle raises the value by a million, to a ceiling of 10M. Steps and Mirror are disabled throughout

goals.title: The Midnight Relock
goals.summary: A rule worth knowing before it happens to you. If Midnight Multiball ends without a single Trapdoor hit, the lock relights and a countdown starts on the playfield clock — relock the last ball in time and you get another ball. Nothing stops that timer.
goals.reward: A second attempt at Midnight Multiball

steps.action: Know which case you are in
steps.detail: One or more Trapdoor hits and the clock simply resets to 5:00 and play continues
The playfield clock shows the seconds left; the timer cannot be paused

goals.title: Build The Rudy Bonus
goals.summary: Jaw hits from the side flipper are the quiet scoring engine of this game. The end-of-ball bonus is 50K per Rudy hit, hits carry from ball to ball, and you begin the game already holding one.
goals.reward: 50K x total Rudy hits at end of ball

steps.action: Work the jaw from the side flipper
steps.detail: Each hit also relights the Mirror award
The count never resets during a game

goals.title: Rudy Gulp
goals.summary: Rudy comments on your play constantly, and while he is talking his mouth is open. Putting a ball in there while he is mid-sentence is a Rudy Gulp for 250K — a shot most players never realise is available outside of midnight.

steps.action: Wait for him to start talking
steps.detail: His mouth is open while he speaks, not just at midnight
250K, and a genuinely satisfying thing to pull off in front of people

goals.title: Million Is Lit
goals.summary: A Mirror award that turns the next Rudy jaw or mouth hit into a flat million. Stack it before Midnight Multiball and the opening mouth shot pays two million instead of one.
goals.reward: 1M on the next Rudy hit, 2M stacked at midnight

steps.detail: Also lit by Quick Multiball

steps.action: Cash it on the jaw or mouth
steps.detail: Holding it into midnight doubles the mouth award

goals.title: Light The Outlane Specials
goals.summary: Get the clock to 11:30 a second time in one game and both outlanes light for Special. The catch is that the lights toggle on and off every time the ball hits a slingshot, and an uncollected Special is gone at the end of the ball.

steps.detail: The clock resets to 5:00 after Midnight Multiball, so this means playing the sequence twice
Every slingshot hit flips the lights on or off — check before you nudge

goals.title: Superdog Time
goals.summary: Shooting the Steps ramp all the way to the top buys 20 seconds of Superdog, and while it runs the three Superdog targets pay 200K and climbing. Both the Superdog and Frenzy timers freeze whenever the ball is in the Wind Tunnel, on the Steps ramp or in the Hidden Hallway lock, and collecting Superdog again mid-Superdog adds another 20 seconds.

steps.action: Shoot the full length of the ramp
steps.detail: Reaching the top is what awards the time
Each adds 5 clock minutes as well

goals.title: The Manhole Shortcut
goals.summary: The single most efficient shot on the machine. The Manhole under the jet bumpers advances the clock 30 minutes — as much as starting a whole ball — and opens the Steps at the same time.

steps.action: Get the ball into the bumper area
steps.detail: The Manhole sits below them
Thirty minutes in one shot, and the Steps open as a bonus

goals.title: You Can Have It Back
goals.summary: FunHouse is unusually generous about bad plunges. A ball that goes from the plunger to the drain without hitting a scoring target is returned — and in practice the game often gives back weak plunges that dribbled through the bumper lane into the right outlane, even though those did touch switches.

steps.action: Do not panic on a bad plunge
steps.detail: The game is more liberal than most about what counts as a wasted ball
Weak plunges down the bumper lane into the right outlane are frequently given back

goals.title: Jet Bumpers At Maximum
goals.summary: A Mirror award that leaves all three bumpers flashing for the rest of the ball. Flashing bumpers are worth 10 clock minutes each instead of nothing, which turns the bumper area from dead time into the fastest clock advance on the playfield.
goals.reward: All bumpers flashing, 10 clock minutes each

steps.detail: Lasts the rest of the ball
Normally worth nothing unlit — now every rattle is 10 minutes

achievements.title: Behind The Head
achievements.desc: Land the plunger skill shot into Rudy's Hideout.

achievements.title: Mind The Gap
achievements.desc: Run the Trapdoor loop and collect the 500K Trapdoor award.

achievements.title: Look In The Mirror
achievements.desc: Collect any Mystery Mirror award from the Wind Tunnel.

achievements.title: Down The Manhole
achievements.desc: Find the Manhole for a 30-minute clock advance.

achievements.title: Frenzy
achievements.desc: Light Frenzy from the Steps and start it at the Trapdoor.

achievements.title: Rudy Gulp
achievements.desc: Feed Rudy's open mouth while he is talking, outside of midnight.

achievements.title: Quick Multiball
achievements.desc: Draw Quick Multiball from the Mirror.

achievements.title: All Six Mirrors
achievements.desc: Collect every Mirror award, then start Super Frenzy.

achievements.title: It's Midnight
achievements.desc: Run the clock to midnight and start Midnight Multiball.

achievements.title: Ten Million
achievements.desc: Climb the Midnight Multiball Trapdoor ladder to its 10M ceiling.

achievements.title: Second Midnight
achievements.desc: Reach 11:30 a second time in one game to light the outlane Specials.

drills.title: Stall the Plunge
drills.text: Not a full-power pull — you want the ball to run out of speed up top and roll back down into the Hideout behind Rudy's head. Work the soft end of the plunger until it stalls in the right place. The value climbs with every collect, which makes this the cheapest big shot on the machine.

drills.title: Loop Into Trapdoor
drills.text: One loop opens the Trapdoor for about eight seconds. The next open costs two consecutive loops and the one after that costs three, but the window never gets any longer. Drill the loop-and-Trapdoor pair as a single motion so the eight seconds are spent shooting rather than deciding.

drills.title: Jaw Work
drills.text: Rudy's jaw comes off the side flipper, not the lower ones. Every hit is end-of-ball bonus that carries between balls and relights the Mirror at the same time, so treat it as the thing you always do when the ball is up there rather than a shot you go hunting for.

drills.title: Find the Manhole
drills.text: Thirty minutes on the clock from one shot, which is as much as a whole ball of ordinary play, and it opens the Steps as well. It sits below the jet bumpers, so practice putting the ball into that area on purpose and then finding the hole, instead of waiting for the bumpers to spit it back out.

drills.title: Gangway Reflex
drills.text: The inlanes cross-light: rolling the inside right flashes the left Gangway, and the left inlane flashes the right one. The light dies in a few seconds, so this is a reflex rather than a plan — take the Gangway straight off the inlane roll without cradling in between.

drills.title: Read the STEPS Light
drills.text: Check the blue light at the Center Ramp entrance before you shoot. With it lit the ramp ends at the Steps plunger instead of returning the ball to your left inlane, so the feed you were expecting never arrives. Take ten ramps with it lit and ten without, and note where you end up each time.

actionButton.how: FunHouse comes from well before cabinet buttons existed. A manual plunger, two flippers and a nudge are your whole toolkit, and even the skill shot is a matter of plunge strength — you want a soft one that stalls in the top loop, not a button press.

howItPlays.objective: FunHouse is a Williams carnival ruled by Rudy, a wisecracking dummy head, and one relentless clock. Push that clock from eight in the evening around to midnight and Rudy nods off with his mouth hanging open, which is your cue to start Midnight Multiball.
loop: Nearly every switch nudges the clock ahead, so chase the fat advances first -- the Manhole beneath the jets and each new ball are half-hour jumps on their own.
Run the right loop to swing the Trapdoor open for a breath under ten seconds, then bury the ball through it for a climbing award.
Feed Rudy's jaw off the upper side flipper to stack end-of-ball bonus and re-arm the Wind Tunnel mirror award.
Once the hands reach half past eleven, only a Hidden Hallway lock moves them, so lock there and again at eleven forty-five to hit the top of the hour.
At midnight, shoot Rudy's open mouth, then climb the Trapdoor ladder as it grows a million richer each cycle.

lights.name: The Clock
lights.lit: The clock face is the master progress bar; it opens in the evening, holds its reading between balls, and almost every switch you rattle walks it toward midnight.
lights.then: Chase the biggest jumps first, then respect the wall at half past eleven, where a Hidden Hallway lock becomes the only thing that moves the hands. Reach midnight and Rudy sleeps for the multiball this whole game is building toward.

lights.name: Trapdoor
lights.lit: Running the right loop pops the Trapdoor open for roughly eight seconds; while it gapes it is the richest single target on the lower playfield.
lights.then: Loop, then drop the ball through the open door for a reward that climbs from half a million to a full one as you chain more loops per opening. During Midnight Multiball this same hole becomes a ladder worth millions.

lights.name: The Steps
lights.lit: Clearing the S-T-E-P target bank lights one step on its own little ramp, always in a fixed order, and a lit step only pays while its lamp is on.
lights.then: Complete the letters to light Frenzy, then a points step, then the extra ball last; hit a lit step to bank it, or send the ball the whole length of the ramp to buy Superdog time.

lights.name: Mystery Mirror
lights.lit: The white Mirror lamp glows as each ball begins and lets the Wind Tunnel pay one of six mystery awards; collect it and the lamp goes dark until you arm it again.
lights.then: Cash whatever award is flashing, then relight the Mirror with a hit to Rudy's jaw or a quick roll through the right-center lane. Draw all six awards over a game and the Wind Tunnel upgrades into Super Frenzy instead.

lights.name: The Gangways
lights.lit: A Gangway starts flashing only when the opposite inlane feeds it, and the flash is gone within a couple of seconds, making this a snap collect rather than a shot you line up.
lights.flashing: A flashing Gangway is live for its climbing award; strike an unlit one and it merely begins flashing instead of paying.
lights.then: Roll the inside right inlane and immediately take the left Gangway, or use the left inlane and the loop to arm the right one. Its value grows across balls until it finally lights the extra ball.

lights.name: Jet Bumpers
lights.lit: Unlit, the three jets add nothing to the clock; lit they are worth a few minutes each, and flashing they are worth double that.
lights.flashing: All three flash for the rest of the ball after the Jets At Maximum mirror award, turning dead bumper time into the fastest clock climb on the table.
lights.then: Light the jets from the lane beside them before you send the ball into the nest, or draw Jets At Maximum from the Mirror to leave them flashing. Every rattle then feeds the run to midnight.

lights.name: Rudy
lights.lit: Rudy talks all game and his mouth hangs open while he speaks, not only at midnight; each jaw hit off the upper side flipper banks bonus that carries between balls.
lights.then: Work the jaw to build bonus and relight the Mirror, feed his open mouth mid-sentence for a sneaky Rudy Gulp, and hold a Million Is Lit award so the first midnight mouth shot pays double. During Quick Multiball every Rudy hit is a flat million.

scoring.text: Bank the safe, repeatable stuff and feed the clock. Take the soft-plunge skill shot into Rudy's Hideout, work the jaw for carry-over bonus, and grab the Manhole whenever you can for a half-hour jump that also opens the Steps.

Turn shots into modes. Loop the Trapdoor for its climbing award, finish S-T-E-P to light Frenzy and the extra ball, and pull awards from the Wind Tunnel while keeping a Million Is Lit ready for later.

Drive the clock to midnight, shoot Rudy's sleeping mouth, and climb the Trapdoor ladder as it grows by a million per cycle to its ten-million ceiling. Reopen the door with the center ramp each time to keep the ladder rising.
